description: Java class implementing a vectorized Delta Byte Array reader for Parquet files in Spark, supporting efficient decoding of delta-encoded byte arrays.

classes.name: VectorizedDeltaByteArrayReader
classes.description: Implements vectorized decoding of Delta Byte Array data in Parquet files for Spark.

methods.name: initFromPage
methods.description: Initializes the reader with data from a page, setting up prefix and suffix readers.

methods.name: readBinary
methods.description: Reads a binary value from the data stream.

methods.name: readValues
methods.description: Reads multiple values into a column vector, respecting prefix lengths and suffixes.

methods.name: setPreviousReader
methods.description: Sets the previous value reader to handle page boundary issues.

methods.name: skipBinary
methods.description: Skips over binary values in the data stream.
